x: FRANK THORN can still give Charlie Speechley 15 years or so, but it will be remembered that he was placed third as long ago as the 1926 “Junior.” In this year's race for eight miles he was our fourth man, placed in the thirties, but from this point he dropped back.
Cooper was Individual Winner as member of Surrey A.C. In 1924 F.

Frank Thorn, although in the forties, polished his shoes and raced in both the Open and County Walks. His feet gave him trouble and although he put up a good performance in the Open, he had to retire from the County Race.
Storey, A.L.Fletcher, A.A.Harley, R.F.Elson,H.E.Larman, J.E.Field, J.Rathbone, C.H.Speechley, F.W.Thorn, J.C.Bidgood.

Len Fletcher and Frank Elson have assisted the Club in seven of these eight wins; Tommy Green six times; Fred Rickards on three occasions; Harold King, Frank Thorn and Ted Saunders each twice; and Joe King and Jack Field once each.
